abilities.label: BATTLECRY
abilities.span: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all enemies. If you've played Alleria or Vereesa, repeat for each.

dependencies.detail: 'Alleria' and 'Vereesa' resolved to the Fabled bundle cards TIME_609t1/TIME_609t2; the names also match hero skins and Wild DAL_379 Vereesa Windrunner
Fabled: deck-building bundle, no rule text

decisions.question: 'repeat for each': once per distinct named card played, or per play (copies)?
decisions.discriminating_case: a generated second copy of Alleria was played: 2 or 3 waves

decisions.question: Do minions killed by the first wave die before the repeat (Deathrattles, Reborn in between)?
alternatives: no: they stay mortally wounded and are hit again; deaths after the Battlecry
decisions.chosen: no: they stay mortally wounded and are hit again; deaths after the Battlecry
decisions.discriminating_case: an enemy Reborn minion at 2 Health with Alleria played: it returns only after both waves and keeps 1 Health

decisions.question: 'played' = played from hand this game (not summoned or cast by effects)?
decisions.discriminating_case: Alleria summoned by another effect does not count
